insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Individual: 1L to 15L (Standard) and 3L to 50L (Exclusive) | Family Floater: 2L to 15L (Standard) and 3L to 50L (Exclusive) (as per Schedule of Benefits)

great.name: NCB / Renewal Bonus is non-claim-linked (does not reduce due to claims)
great.quote: On Renewal of this Policy with the Company without a break, a sum equal to 10% of the Base Sum Insured of the expiring Policy shall be provided as multiplier benefit irrespective of any claims ... The maximum multiplier bonus will not exceed 100% of the Basic Sum Insured in any Policy Year.
great.reference: Section B > 5. Renewal Benefits > 5.1 Cumulative Bonus
great.explanation: You get 10% extra Sum Insured each renewal even if you made claims, up to 100% of base SI—this is better than typical NCBs that reduce/reset after a claim.

good.name: Initial waiting period (30 days) — standard
good.quote: 30-day waiting period – Code – Excl03 ... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: 30-day initial waiting is standard in health insurance (accidents covered from day 1).

good.name: Specific disease/procedure waiting period (24 months) — standard
good.quote: Specified disease/procedure waiting period – Code – Excl02 ... excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.
good.reference: Section C > 1(ii) Specified disease/procedure waiting period – Excl02
good.explanation: 24 months for listed surgeries/conditions is industry-standard.

good.name: PED waiting period (36 months) — acceptable/standard
good.quote: Pre-Existing Diseases – Code – Excl01 ... excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: 3-year PED waiting period is common; not a red flag under your rules.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover (up to 60 days) — standard
good.quote: Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses for consultations, investigations and medicines incurred upto 60 days before the date of admission to the Hospital
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses up to 60 days before admission (standard/good).

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover (up to 90 days) — standard
good.quote: Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses for consultations, investigations and medicines incurred upto 90 days after discharge from Hospitalisation
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses up to 90 days after discharge (standard/good).

good.name: Air ambulance covered (plan-variant dependent) — bonus/standard benefit
good.quote: Emergency Air Ambulance Cover ... d(i)The amount payable in case of Air ambulance facility shall be either the actual expenses or Rs. 2.5 Lacs per hospitalization, whichever is lower; upto basic sum insured limit for a year
good.reference: Section B > 2(d) Emergency Air Ambulance Cover
good.explanation: Air ambulance is covered with a limit of up to ₹2.5 lakhs per hospitalization (only where opted/available as per schedule).

bad.name: Consumables not covered (explicit non-payable list includes gloves, masks, etc.)
bad.quote: Annexure I – List I - Items for which coverage is not available in the policy ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 62 OXYGEN MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure I – List I (Items for which coverage is not available)
bad.explanation: Common consumables (e.g., gloves, masks, kits) are out-of-pocket, which can materially increase your hospital bill.

bad.name: No restore benefit (sum insured not replenished after a claim)
bad.quote: No explicit restore/reinstatement/refill benefit mentioned in provided policy wording text.
bad.reference: Document scan (no restore clause found in Benefits/Renewal sections provided)
bad.explanation: No restore benefit: Sum Insured is NOT replenished after a claim. Multiple hospitalizations in the same year can exhaust coverage faster.

bad.name: Room rent limit not stated (can cause unexpected out-of-pocket due to room category restrictions)
bad.quote: This includes • Hospital room rent or boarding; ... (no room rent eligibility/capping stated in the provided extract).
bad.explanation: Room rent eligibility (Any room/Single AC/percentage cap) is not stated in the extract. If the actual policy has a room cap, it can lead to proportionate deductions.

bad.name: Maternity waiting period is very long where maternity is offered (4–6 years depending on variant)
bad.quote: Schedule of Benefits – Easy Health Individual ... [Waiting Period of 6 years] ... [Waiting Period of 4 Years] ... Schedule of Benefits – Easy Health Family ... [Waiting Period 4 years] ... [Waiting Period of 3 Years]
bad.reference: Schedule of Benefits – Easy Health Individual / Easy Health Family (Maternity Expenses row)
bad.explanation: If you buy this policy for maternity planning, the waiting period is long (3–6 years depending on plan), which delays eligibility significantly.

unclear.name: Co-pay / cost-sharing terms not explicitly stated (beyond definitions)
unclear.quote: Co-payment means a cost-sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claim amount.
unclear.reference: Section A > Standard Definitions > Def. 8 Co-payment
unclear.explanation: The document defines co-pay but does not clearly state whether any co-pay applies by default (0%/10%/20% etc.). Confirm from policy schedule or product specifics.

unclear.name: Cashless network size not specified
unclear.quote: Network Provider means Hospital enlisted by an insurer or a TPA ... to provide medical services to an insured by a cashless facility.
unclear.reference: Section A > Standard Definitions > Def. 30 Network Provider
unclear.explanation: No number of network hospitals is provided here. Network depth impacts cashless convenience—check HDFC ERGO’s current network list for your city.

unclear.name: Modern treatments / robotic / advanced procedures sub-limits not specified
unclear.explanation: The extract doesn’t specify if modern treatments (e.g., robotic surgery, advanced therapies) have sub-limits. Verify from full policy wording/schedule.

unclear.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer (beyond NCB) not mentioned
unclear.quote: No explicit clause found in provided text for additional SI buffer that activates after base SI is exhausted (e.g., Secure Benefit/Enhanced SI/Super top-up buffer).
unclear.explanation: Apart from the renewal Cumulative Bonus, no separate built-in buffer (that kicks in after base SI is exhausted during the same policy year) is visible in the extract.
